executablePolicy: Exact admitted path identities, preserve original argv0 aliases such as ranlib. No executable directory blanket.
readDataPolicy: Exact literal source/tool/header/stub/library/cache files only; no blanket SDK/toolchain/system/home read permission.
metadataPolicy: Only ancestors and exact admitted files plus declared negative SDK candidate observations; do not equate metadata permission with byte permission.

generatedExecutables.role: Repeated configure compiler/link/run probe, one admission per generation
One later version-only observation, not configure/make script execution
Version-report helper used by .build prerequisite, not a shell oracle
Pipe-size helper invoked through source psize.sh; actual target reachability pending
Conditional helpfile generator; no execution allowance unless configured graph admits it

generatedAdmission: Source/recipe/probe generation + compiler argv + output identity must be recorded. Exact-path sandbox is not atomic hash interposition; executable admission implementation remains unqualified.
scriptBoundary: An admitted interpreter can execute inline/stdin/owned-script code; process-exec path rules alone do not authenticate script content or argv. Source read scope and audited recipe graph are distinct controls.
environmentPolicy: Fresh exact map; no inherited ENV/BASH_ENV/functions/flags/credentials/DYLD variables. Driver flag support is unexecuted; failure is a refusal, not permission to remove flags silently.

census.eslogger: Installed identity only; privileges/TCC/schema/filtering/completeness untested; broad host event capture forbidden.

revision: Source-only explicit selector binding plus corrected actual GNU 5.3 generated helper edges; P1 retained, no runtime rescore.
